subject: Evaluation plan & MAP — security gates addendum and retention terms
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@horizonpay.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@horizonpay.com
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation plan & MAP — security gates addendum and retention terms

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — HorizonPay's evaluation team is aligned to move ahead with a short MAP to validate security controls and retention behavior before procurement signs the PO.

High level asks from our side (security + procurement):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and the auditor name
- SIG/CAIQ questionnaire or evidence matrix mapped to your controls
- Draft DPA and any proposed retention defaults (we need 3/5/7 year scenarios)
- Clarify how private deployments (VPC) change data residency assumptions

We want to keep the MAP timeboxed: proof-of-concept + security evidence intake -> target close in 3 weeks. Can you send a MAP draft that lists deliverables, owners, and acceptance gates for SOC 2 / SIG / DPA items? Procurement is copied for timeline visibility.

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Head of Platform Security, HorizonPay
anna.lopez@horizonpay.com
attachments: none
From: lukas.meyer@redwood.ai
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@horizonpay.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & MAP — security gates addendum and retention terms

Anna — thanks, and great to meet the team. Attaching a short MAP (HorizonPay_MAP_v2.xlsx) that breaks the plan into three workstreams: 1) evidence intake (SOC2/SIG), 2) technical POC + data residency checks, 3) DPA + procurement. Key points:

- Proposed timeline: 3-week MAP, kickoff Mon 2026-03-23, handoff/acceptance by Fri 2026-04-10.
- SOC 2: attaching Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted) — auditor: Aurora Assurance. We'll also map controls to SIG CAIQ items in tab 'SIG-mapping' in the MAP.
- DPA: we'll accept a redline; kimberly will lead legal review. Our default retention is 90 days for session/interaction logs, 1 year for prompts/embeddings unless customers request custom retention. We can propose 3/5/7 year retention addenda as a contract appendix.
- Private/VPC: data egress/residency constraints are controllable; for HorizonPay we'd recommend Dedicated or Private with regional tenancy to meet residency needs.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick kickoff tomorrow to confirm owners (HorizonPay: security + procurement; Redwood: lukas + kimberly + marcus).
2) HorizonPay to confirm which retention tier you expect by Tue EOD.
3) HorizonPay to send the SIG/CAIQ baseline (if you have a prefilled copy) so we can mark open items.

CC'd kimberly (legal) and marcus (infosec) to track the DPA redline and the controls mapping.

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.ai
attachments: HorizonPay_MAP_v2.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & MAP — security gates addendum and retention terms

Anna / Lukas — quick note from legal on DPA and retention:

- We'll accept most standard DPA redlines but need to review data deletion/return obligations and subprocessor list. Suggest HorizonPay send any company-specific clauses up front.
- Retention options: we can include a retention appendix to the DPA with selectable tiers (90d, 1yr, 3yr, 5yr, 7yr). For very long retention (5/7yr) we'll require a fee schedule for extended storage and periodic security attestations.
- Escrow/escape hatch: for regulated jurisdictions we recommend a staging plan in the MAP: define the accept criteria for the POC and a fallback if residency or encryption controls don't meet your internal audit.

I attached a redline stub (DPA_redline_20260323.docx) with comments on indemnity and breach notification timing. Marcus — can you confirm whether the current SOC 2 cover for key controls (encryption in transit/at rest, access reviews) is sufficient for HorizonPay's auditors?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
attachments: DPA_redline_20260323.docx

Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & MAP — security gates addendum and retention terms

Thanks everyone — this looks good as a starter. A few clarifications from HorizonPay:

- Procurement: we will target the 3-week MAP timeline. Procurement will need the DPA redline and an invoice estimate to open a purchase request by 2026-03-26.
- Security: Marcus, please confirm whether Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf covers encryption key management (KMS/HSM) and periodic access review evidence. If not, we will ask for the CAIQ mapping to focus on those areas.
- Retention: HorizonPay prefers 3-year default in the contract appendix; procurement will flag any exceptions. Please include the fee schedule for 5/7 year retention options in the MAP financial tab.

Action items we took away:
1) Redwood: finalize MAP workbook with the DPA appendix and fee schedule (Lukas / Kimberly).
2) HorizonPay: send any non-standard DPA clauses and a prefilled SIG if available (Anna / Procurement).
3) Marcus to confirm SOC2 control coverage by EOD tomorrow.

I'll route to procurement once we have the DPA redline and invoice estimate.

Best,
Anna
Head of Platform Security, HorizonPay
